placements.title: Commanding erasure of specific knowledge from the record
placements.frame: What does it mean to direct that knowledge be removed, and what claims justify that removal?
placements.why: All three segments concern the removal of knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration: src-1 and src-2 are imperatives commanding total erasure of specific artifacts and work, and src-3 is a corrective assertion supplying the factual basis — that the calibration never occurred — which justifies the removal. The theme (directing what the record retains) is a subject future envelopes could keep feeding, passing the grain test. No existing leaves or strata exist to reuse.
